description: This file defines the Studio2.PanelDD class, which manages drag-and-drop behavior for panels within the SuiteCRM Module Builder interface. It includes methods for starting, ending, and handling drag-and-drop events, as well as related visual updates and panel manipulation logic.

classes.name: Studio2.PanelDD
classes.description: A class extending YAHOO.util.DDProxy that manages drag-and-drop actions for panels in the SuiteCRM Module Builder UI.

methods.name: startDrag
methods.description: Initializes the drag operation, creating a proxy element that visually represents the panel being dragged, and handles special cases for toolbox panels.

methods.name: endDrag
methods.description: Completes the drag operation, determining whether to remove, reposition, or reconfigure the panel based on the drop target and state.

methods.name: onInvalidDrop
methods.description: Handles invalid drop actions, clearing the proxy and resetting states.

methods.name: onDragDrop
methods.description: Detects drop events where a panel is moved into the delete area and sets a flag for removal.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging movement, updating the position of panels in real-time.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Provides visual cues and reorder logic when a dragged panel hovers over potential drop targets.
